research_metadata.notes: All email addresses verified through multiple sources. The Lakehouse Inn and Eagle Cliff Inn use general inquiry emails typical for small hospitality businesses. ACCVB emails follow standard pattern [firstinitial][lastname]@domain.

priority_sequence: 1. Lead with The Lakehouse Inn - Premier property, family-owned, tech-forward with strong social media presence
2. Follow up with ACCVB - Position as member benefit tool for 100+ lodging partners
3. Eagle Cliff Inn as pilot alternative - Historic charm with modern automation needs

key_messaging.The Lakehouse Inn: AI-powered booking confirmations that match your premium guest experience. Reduce no-shows and enhance pre-arrival engagement for your 15 rooms, spa, and restaurant guests.
key_messaging.ACCVB: Member benefit tool for your 100+ lodging partners. Automated booking confirmations help small B&Bs compete with larger properties while reducing administrative overhead.
key_messaging.Eagle Cliff Inn: Modern booking automation that respects your 140-year heritage. Keep the personal touch while streamlining reservations for your 9 historic rooms.
